review_type: Independent read-only source and edge-order review; no test or frequency claim
reasoning: At an acceptance edge, admission data, ingress_pending and the one-hot allocation_pending vector capture the same request. At the following edge allocation_pending selects exactly the slot selected by ingress_pending plus admission.tag. Pending ingress forbids another acceptance, and reset clears both validity representations.

Each slot owner preserves consume -> formatter reservation/final metadata -> compression return -> registered admission -> fresh reservation nonblocking assignment priority. No old dynamic next_hash/finish_node context writer survives.

DESCRIBE samples small address metadata and PREPARE writes the existing packed address register before BUILD reads it. Fast first prefix blocks read seeds/random/key/paired values, never the packed address. Global tree/layer/identifier fields remain governed by their existing active-job lifetime.

H2 replaces CS(SigmaE,Ch,prefix_sum) then CS(prefix_carry,second_sum,second_carry) with CS(prefix_sum,prefix_carry,Ch) then CS(second_sum,second_carry,SigmaE). Each compressor preserves sum modulo2^32; all downstream A/E and message schedule expressions are unchanged.
remaining_risks: Local combinational event and scalar-byte-mask OR logic can still be merged by synthesis; only actual target routing proves the hard frequency.
Constant-slot context writers may change RAM/FF mapping and area.
G5 relies on the existing job-common tree/layer/identifier stability contract, which already spans each multi-block hash.
Component evidence is not substituted for the combined-source 690 actual-RAM/432 full-slot and further integration tests being run independently by the validation owner.
